dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple closed-loop 'O' and open 'C' shaped structures exhibit jagged, high-frequency perimeters of light-intensity pixels; the most prominent structures on the posterior region show a sharp gradient transition from a 1-3 pixel wide light exterior to a dark interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid light-intensity clusters localized in the central-lateral region; these clusters lack internal gradients and form a concentrated aggregate of irregularly shaped white-gray pixel islands against the primary dark background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest posterior annuli form a nearly equilateral triangle; a secondary geometric relationship is defined by a linear chain of four smaller high-intensity blobs extending from the mid-section toward the ventral edge.
